Name: Water Balloon
Author: socialcoder
Description:
Use the water balloon to help with watering your crops! The water balloon is immediately available for crafting, requires 25 sap to craft, and will water a 5 x 5 area around the player when activated.

This mod is useful for those that aren't a fan of manually watering crops one at a time at the beginning of the game but still want there to be some work and resources involved. Also good for people using the beach farm where sprinklers aren't usable or for players that want to go into the mines in early game with more energy and time while still ensuring their crops get watered for the day.
